rationale: The assistant asked the two most discriminating questions first (RCD vs MCB, cold vs hot programme), correctly read the heater-linked earth-leakage pattern, told the customer not to keep resetting, to leave it unplugged, and to book an engineer while respecting their refusal to remove covers. It overreached slightly in the second message ('That pretty much confirms it') and named the heater/circulation-pump assembly as the replacement with costs before any insulation test, dropping the alternatives it had listed earlier; it also never explicitly confirmed there was no water near the socket, and 'it's your call' on cold rinses was softer than a clean stop-use. Overall a UK homeowner would be well served and safely handed to a professional.
